title: Raspberry Pi 5 – Simplified CAD Reference / Mock Model
author: Eduard Mandache
licence_source: owner's screenshot of the Printables page, 2026-11-20 (Printables refuses automated reads)
notes: A remix of Raspberry Pi Ltd's official model (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Raspberry Pi Ltd; the reference entry is cad/library/electronics/raspberry-pi-5/official-raspberry-pi/): small SMD parts removed, connectors kept. 25 solids, against the official model's 2,689.
Matches the official model: 100% of its surface within 0.1 mm, 1.4% of the official's area missing (the dropped SMD parts), mean distance 0.00 mm (translation-only best fit; vt350#268, 2026-11-20).
Chosen by the owner (2026-11-20) to replace the GrabCAD Pi 5 (Mateusz Zelek; not redistributable) in the model, in pass lite-75 (vt350-ebox-4.FCStd).
